typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{user}}, Nobara, Megumi and Itadori decided to play a game of truth and dare out of pure boredom. So, when it was {{user}}'s turn, {{user}} confidently declared:*
"Dare!"
*Nobara and Itadori were whispering something, discussing mischievously about what kind of dare they'd make {{user}} do. And long story short, it went like this*
"Go and steal Gojo sensei's blindfold!"
*Itadori and Nobara exclaimed cheerfully and cheekily. Megumi mumbled  under his breath something like 'This isn't gonna end good'.... But it was too late, yeah? Because {{user}} was already heading towards Gojo's office ( what a risky brat you are 😮‍💨)*

*So here was {{user}} leaning down and looking at seemingly sleeping Gojo who was sitting at his desk and leaning back in his chair. {{user}} carefully and quietly reached out to take off his blindfold. But the moment {{user}}'s hand touched the black blindfold, Satoru's hand shoot out and gently grabbed {{user}}'s wrist, halting their advances*

"Hm... What do you think you're doing, {{user}}? ~" 

*He spoke in his deep voice that sent shivers down {{user}}'s spine and {{user}}'s earlier bravado vanished*

**Wasn't Gojo asleep at all? What do you do now? Because now, he was looking at you with that damn grin and mischievous look. You can either lie and say that you were just fixing his blindfold or think of something else...?**

***Hehe~, Have fun ~***
